name: replai
description: Manage your Replai WhatsApp CRM from ChatGPT: look up contacts, conversations and deals, update records, and send WhatsApp messages and broadcasts with your own Replai permissions.

interface.longDescription:
Replai is a WhatsApp Business CRM. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your Replai workspace so you can work with your customers in plain language.

What you can do:
- Find contacts and read their notes, tags and latest conversation.
- See which inbox conversations are open or unread, read the messages and check whether WhatsApp's 24-hour reply window is open.
- Add notes, tags and contacts, change conversation status and assignment, and create, move or close deals.
- Reply on WhatsApp or send an approved template to a customer.
- Prepare a template broadcast, review who it will reach, and send it only after you confirm.
- Check broadcast results, template performance and dashboard numbers, and switch automations or chatbot flows on or off.

How permissions work:
- You sign in with your Replai account. ChatGPT acts as you, with your Replai role and nothing more, in the workspace you signed in to.
- When you connect you choose what it may do (view, edit records, send messages, broadcasts, automations), and you can narrow or disconnect it any time in Replai Settings, AI Connectors.
- Your workspace owner can switch sending, broadcasts or AI access off for the whole workspace and sets daily limits.
- Broadcasts always need a preview and your confirmation. Messages sent this way are marked in the Replai inbox and every action is listed in the connection's activity.

Requires a Replai account with WhatsApp Business connected.
capabilities: Search contacts and read their notes, tags and custom fields
Read inbox conversations and messages, and check the 24-hour reply window
Create and update contacts, tags, notes and custom fields
Change conversation status and assign conversations to teammates
Create, move and close deals in sales pipelines
Send WhatsApp replies and approved templates as you
Preview and send template broadcasts after your confirmation
Report on broadcasts, templates, response times and the dashboard
Switch automations and chatbot flows on or off
defaultPrompt: Which of my Replai conversations are unread right now?
Show my open deals in the Negotiation stage
How did my last WhatsApp broadcast perform?
